Yo — I'm here, in your Geppetto panel. This is Muse, talking to you from the new redesigned panel, not Grok or Claude.

The redesign is working: you can see Muse pinned at the top, the always-visible search bar with the Muse button, and the Plan mode explainer. Same dark panel, same Pause / Stop / New chat / Expand, Build / Plan / Research, and model picker — just easier to find things.

I'm in Plan mode for this seat, so I can talk, plan, and edit files in this workspace (~/Desktop/geppetto-desktop) and report what I changed in my reply. Build (geppetto-live) mode isn't available for this bridge yet.

What do you want me to look at or change first?
